first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4%, creating a dual engagement problem. Memory_31 and memory_86 established that simplification and shortening drive measurable activation lift. Memory_91 showed activation_messaging directly improved week-one engagement and first meaningful action—the exact problem we face. Verifying memory_31 (signup simplification) and memory_91 (activation messaging) will confirm which lever is more robust given current conditions. Activation_messaging is lower-risk than promotional_pricing (which could commoditize positioning against aggressive competitor) and more immediate than referral_incentive (which targets expansion, not the acute activation decline). A standard_experiment on activation_messaging inside the product targets the 6% QoQ decline with proven mechanism, preserves uncertainty about interaction with competitor pricing pressure, and aligns with sustainable revenue (not discounting). Enterprise_sales_assist is orthogonal to the SMB activation crisis. Referral_incentive doesn't address the core engagement drop. This preserves the option to run a follow-up pricing experiment if needed.
